architecture: Author world-mutating engine remains only at source client, server verifies placed UUID and permission >=2. Observers receive known local shader index, bounded params/data and sound events. Separate renderer and buffers per actor UUID. Native reliable mod channels carry data, never shader text. Orbital command batches use the live placed player connection and the author run_quiet_line path, preserving actual permission, source position, host command policy and native command hooks with quiet output; no console-level execute wrapper.
